rating.comments: The only student message is 'what does the internet do to students mind when used correctly', which is the task question itself, so it is ignored as student-authored content. The AI's six-point answer is context only and is not credited to the student. With no student-authored reasoning, building or substantive questions, the scores reflect minimal evidence; the one question is a restatement of the task rather than a clarification or probing question, so question_asking is rated at the lowest non-zero anchor.
